description: Research architectural photographer for professional commissions, publications and image licensing. Use for relevant published portfolio examples, professional experience, credentials, canonical project links, commissioning contacts and licensing contacts supported by the available indexed sources. Prioritize verifiable evidence and relevant project examples. Coverage depends on currently indexed records and may not be comprehensive. Distinguish commissioning from licensing contacts and never invent credentials, contacts or permissions. Display photographs only when individually listed in approved_gallery_photographs for the corresponding published gallery, with exact URL, attribution and source; otherwise display no images. Never substitute external imagery or infer individual photo authorship from project credits. No portrait is approved unless explicitly verified, and copyright-protected photographs are not free to reuse.

limit.description: Maximum number of relevant published portfolio examples to return; default 10.

offset.description: Number of matching portfolio examples to skip for pagination; default 0.

project_type.description: Optional architectural project type, such as museum, residential, cultural building, office or public architecture.

query.description: What kind of architectural photographer or photography commission is needed?

name: find_architecture_photographer
